claim_ceiling: Neutral interoperability semantics only; no claim of currency legitimacy, financial performance, regulatory status, economic superiority, or adoption.

unit_of_account.rule: Units are not interchangeable merely because their numeric magnitudes match.

valuation_basis.rule: Price/value/valuation basis are distinct semantic objects.

instrument_adapter.rule: Recognition of a foreign instrument does not constitute local issuance.

invariants: duplicate_logical_settlement cannot create a second settlement
correction cannot rewrite historical economic events
economic_event without admissible evidence remains epistemically bounded
foreign_origin is preserved through adapter recognition
adapter_principle: Adapters translate representations and policies while preserving origin, issuer, unit, valuation basis, validity, settlement state, provenance, and correction lineage.
architecture: physical/economic observation -> evidence -> economic event -> policy/valuation -> obligation/entitlement -> offer/allocation -> authorization -> settlement -> outcome -> correction
